FIELDS.NAME: Leather & Luggage Co.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Leather & Luggage Co. specializes in retailing a diverse range of premium leather goods and luggage products, focusing on quality craftsmanship and exceptional customer service. Our operations include sourcing high-quality materials, maintaining a well-organized inventory that is securely monitored to prevent losses, and providing a seamless shopping experience both in-store and through our established online sales platform. We ensure that all our products meet the highest standards of durability and design, appealing to both local and global customers. Our team is trained in loss prevention strategies, enhancing our operational reliability and minimizing risks associated with theft or vandalism claims, which are crucial to maintaining our business integrity.

Our store prioritizes customer accessibility and engagement, often leaving our doors unlocked during business hours to encourage foot traffic and browse-in visits, while relying on our friendly staff to monitor the area.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: "Leather & Luggage Warehouse, LLC - 456 Luggage Blvd, Chicago, IL 60614"
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 3, 2023, an employee discovered an inventory discrepancy that led to a loss of $5,000 due to a minor theft incident. The store was equipped with basic security measures, including locked display cases and alarm systems. The case is currently under review, and measures have been implemented to improve security protocols.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: "Monday to Saturday: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Sunday: Closed"
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: "Class II, UL Listed, Grade 1 Safe with biometric access and 24/7 monitoring system."
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Basic security protocols are in place, including a monitoring system for inventory storage, and staff are trained in loss prevention strategies.
